title: Embedded EVSE Platform
description: Embedded software platform for smart AC EV charging stations. ARM-based SoC with custom Linux (Yocto), modular C++ applications via IPC message bus. Includes OCPP protocol, cybersecurity (HSM, secure boot), and smart charging algorithms.

title: EVSE Infrastructure
description: Full software architecture for Linux-based EV charging stations. OCPP 1.6 implementation, smart charging algorithms, power management, cybersecurity layer, and custom Yocto Linux distribution.

title: Advanced Embedded Linux Capstone
description: Capstone project for the Advanced Embedded Linux Development specialization (University of Colorado Boulder). Custom embedded root filesystem and Linux distribution using Yocto/Buildroot, plus WiFi video streaming implementation over an embedded Linux platform.

title: Pharmaceutical IoT Monitoring System
description: IoT solution for pharmaceutical cold chain tracking and temperature monitoring. Real-time web dashboard integrated with 25+ hospital facilities, ensuring drug transport compliance.

title: Voltage Transformer Testing Automation
description: Automated testing system for voltage transformer quality control. WinForms application with Modbus PLC communication and tester device API integration.

title: Clash Ninja
description: VR-based videogame developed as Bachelor thesis for the 3D4Amb project, aimed at treating amblyopia (lazy eye) through immersive gameplay.

title: Brain Tumor Classification
description: Machine learning models for brain tumor recognition from CT scan images, built for educational purposes.
